cause: The reused browser guard incorrectly required a prepared context reference for an empty-context task; the current workbench deliberately sends planningContext=null when there is no context source.
codeEvidence: PromptWorkbenchPage.prepareContextForPlan returns true without preparation when hasContextSource=false; buildOptimizationPlanRequest serializes the absent reference as null.
fix: Require the exact native no-context Plan body, compare missing/null confirmation references using the same DTO semantics, and retain real planId/question/answer binding.
